## C2 — KG hints for License Categories, Driving Tests, Renewal and Other License Information

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A02
Renewal is allowed during the six months before expiration and during the year after it, but the license itself is void from the moment it expires with no grace period [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint renewal; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F19 and sec02-F21.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A02
A vision test is required at every renewal, while the in-person visit is required only at every other renewal because one mail renewal is allowed in between [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint renewal; prereq_hint sec02-R01; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F22 and sec02-F20.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A03
An address change is reported in writing within thirty days, while a name change is reported in person within thirty days with proof [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint license-changes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec02-F24 and sec02-F25.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
Class three stops at a gross vehicle weight rating of eighteen thousand pounds, class four runs from eighteen thousand one to twenty-six thousand pounds, and commercial classes begin at twenty-six thousand one pounds [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F06 and sec02-F07.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A01
Commercial class A requires the towed units to exceed ten thousand pounds, while class B is a heavy single vehicle whose towed unit does not exceed ten thousand pounds [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint sec02-R04; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F08 and sec02-F09.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A01
Endorsement P covers vehicles built for sixteen or more passengers, while endorsement S covers school buses specifically and endorsement T covers double and triple trailers [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint endorsements; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec02-F11 and sec02-F10.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A04
A traffic infraction can be settled by paying, writing a statement or appearing, while a traffic crime requires a court appearance because jail is possible [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint citations; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec02-F39 and sec02-F40.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A02
An autocycle is legal to drive on a category three license, yet it is not allowed as the vehicle for the category three performance test [A02].
Why it matters: group_hint driving-tests; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F14 and sec02-F06.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A04
Any category of driver's license permits moped operation, while a category one license is the route for a person who has no license at all [A04].
Why it matters: group_hint mopeds; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint one; confusable_with sec02-F36 and sec02-F37.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A01
A provisional driver's late-night exceptions are work and school activities, while the late-night passenger limit of one person under eighteen is lifted only when a parent or guardian rides along [A01].
Why it matters: group_hint provisional-rules; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F01 and sec02-F02.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A03
Lettered codes can identify required aids and driving limits; numbered codes include equipment requirements, medical restrictions and three-wheel motorcycle operation [A03].
Why it matters: group_hint restrictions; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint two; confusable_with sec02-F29 and sec02-F30.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-hi-x:hawaii-department-of-transportation-hdot:handbook:pdf-0016]
